subject: Clearframe renewal — onboarding cadence & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam@clearframe.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@clearframe.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Clearframe renewal kickoff — proposed cadence and QBR

Hi Sam —

Hope you had a good week. As we talked about on the renewal call, I wanted to start a short kickoff thread to lock down the timeline, stakeholders, and a QBR slot so we can align procurement + onboarding teams. High-level goals from Redwood's side:

- Confirm target term & headcount/throughput commitment for 2027
- Agree on a mutually acceptable onboarding cadence (tech ramp, SRE runbook, and billing cadence)
- Schedule an initial QBR that includes your engineering + procurement leads and our Customer Success + Solutions Engineer

Proposal:
1) Target effective date for the renewal: 2027-01-01
2) Onboarding cadence: 4-week ramp (Week 0: SOW + credentials; Weeks 1–3: capacity ramp and blue/green verification)
3) QBR window: week of Jan 10–14, prefer Jan 11 or 12 for exec-level attendees

Attached: a gap-level Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a thin SOW with the proposed throughput uplift. Can you confirm: (a) internal approvers we should include, (b) whether Legal will want to review the SOW before we schedule the QBR, and (c) any blackout dates the week of Jan 10?

If it helps, I can run a 30-minute tech + ops sync next week to walk the MAP with your infra team.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

[Attachment: 20261114-Clearframe-MAP.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Clearframe-SOW-v2.docx (docx)]

From: Sam Lee <sam@clearframe.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@clearframe.com>, Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@clearframe.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clearframe renewal kickoff — proposed cadence and QBR

Connor —

Thanks for kicking this off and for the draft MAP. Quick answers:

- Approvers: Priya (Procurement), Claire (Legal), and our CTO (Michael Ortiz) — copying Priya and Claire.
- Legal will want to review the SOW; Claire will lead that. Expect a 5–7 business day review once we hand off the doc.
- Blackout dates: CTO is away Jan 12–13; Jan 11 looks best for exec presence.

We'd like the capacity uplift staged: 50% in Month 1, full throughput by Month 3 — that matches our traffic pattern. A technical walkthrough with your SE would be useful; can we do Wed Nov 18 11:00am PT? Priya, Claire, does that time work for you for the internal prep?

Thanks,
Sam
VP of Product | Clearframe
sam@clearframe.com | (415) 888-2020

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Clearframe renewal — prep & immediate asks

Team —

Quick internal note after Sam's reply. Key asks and proposed owners:

- Legal review path (owner: Karthik) — Claire Hsu at Clearframe will take the lead; we should prepare redline guidance and a suggested SOW clause for staged throughput. Target turnaround: 5 business days after handoff.
- MAP walkthrough (owner: Soojin) — schedule 30m with their infra team on Wed Nov 18 11:00am PT (Sam requested). SE/Onboarding to demo ramp plan and KV cache warm-up expectations.
- Exec QBR scheduling (owner: Marissa) — Sam prefers Jan 11 for exec presence; block that on our side and prep a short agenda (30–45m).
- Billing/finance checkpoint (owner: Connor) — confirm billing start date alignment with effective date 2027-01-01; prep prorated invoice template if onboarding runs into Jan.

Attachments: MAP + SOW (see thread). I'll handoff the SOW to Karthik after the MAP walkthrough so Legal has the final context.

Small tactical: Soojin — please prepare an ops runbook doc stub (15–20 bullets) we can send with the MAP to speed Claire's review. Marissa — when you block Jan 11 please propose two adjacent times (11:00am or 2:00pm PT).

Thanks —
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Clearframe MAP walkthrough scheduled + QBR hold (Jan 11)

Hi Sam / Priya / Claire —

Thanks for the quick responses. Per the thread:

- MAP walkthrough: Wed Nov 18 11:00am PT — invite sent to your infra lead. SE will demo the ramp and SRE checks.
- Legal handoff: Karthik will send redline guidance within 24 hours after our MAP walkthrough so you have suggested language ready for Claire's review.
- QBR: Holding Jan 11, 2027 at 11:00am PT for an executive sync (30–45m). Please let us know if we should shift to 2:00pm per Marissa's follow-up — otherwise we'll go with 11:00am.

Next steps (what each side will do this week):
- Clearframe: confirm internal approvers and any additional blackout dates for Jan week (Sam/Priya)
- Redwood: SE/Onboarding to run MAP walkthrough; Karthik to prepare redline guidance; Marissa to circulate QBR agenda and calendar hold.

I've attached the MAP and the latest SOW (v2) for Claire's intake. Claire — when you're ready I can provide a short bulleted list of acceptance criteria we typically use to speed SOW signoff.

Look forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
